method.name: Ordered-block + nuisance-Hellinger
method.parser: longest digit run; alphabetic separators split runs; retain values 1..355
method.response_score: shared nuisance-Hellinger and ordered-block environment/nuisance fusion
method.aggregation: mean of response-wise fused class z-scores
method.probability: uniform-prior softmax with fusion-specific grouped cross-validation temperature scaling

source_scope: ModelTrace reference outputs (pre/at GPT-5.6 & Claude) plus post-GPT-5.6 reference outputs from Ikaleio/lm-detector (MIT).
